title: svt_usb_if.svi signal interface layer -- verified complete sub-interface list, DUT-facing modports, and widths
summary: include/sverilog/svt_usb_if.svi defines `interface svt_usb_if()` (line 150), the container interface a testbench instantiates and passes into the VIP. Verifies and substantially extends a prior finding (which only named svt_usb_utmi_dut_mac_if/svt_usb_ss_serial_if/svt_usb_20_serial_if): the complete, verified set of sub-interface instances declared inside svt_usb_if is: pipe3_dut_phy_if/pipe3_dut_mac_if (svt_usb_pipe3_dut_phy_if/_mac_if, PIPE3 Gen1/Gen2 SuperSpeed); pipe4_dut_phy_if + pipe4_dut_phy_lane1_if and pipe4_dut_mac_if + pipe4_dut_mac_lane1_if (svt_usb_pipe4_dut_phy_if/_mac_if, PIPE4 Gen2x2 dual-lane -- lane1 instances are the signal-level proof of 2-lane support, matching SVT_USB_NUM_PHY_LANES=2); adapter_dut_phy_if/adapter_dut_mac_if (svt_usb_adapter_dut_phy_if/_mac_if, USB4 tunneling adapter); custom_adapter_dut_phy_if/custom_adapter_dut_mac_if (svt_usb_iip_custom_adapter_dut_phy_if/_mac_if, 'IIP custom adapter' USB4 variant); utmi_dut_phy_if/utmi_dut_mac_if (svt_usb_utmi_dut_phy_if/_mac_if); ulpi_dut_phy_if/ulpi_dut_mac_if (svt_usb_ulpi_dut_phy_if/_mac_if) PLUS a separate, distinct standalone ulpi_if instance (svt_usb_ulpi_if, line 441) not part of the phy/mac pair; usb_ss_serial_if + usb_ss_serial_lane1_if (svt_usb_ss_serial_if, dual-lane); usb_20_serial_if (svt_usb_20_serial_if); usb_20_hsic_if (svt_usb_20_hsic_if); usb_20_eusb2_if (svt_usb_20_eusb2_if); usb_otg_if (svt_usb_otg_if); usb_debug_if (svt_usb_debug_if); and, when SVT_USB_EXCLUDE_SSIC is not defined, four SSIC M-PHY RMMI arrays sized [SVT_USB_MAX_SSIC_LANE_COUNT-1:0] (=4, include/sverilog/svt_usb_port_defines.svi:97): rmmi_mtx_dut_phy_if, rmmi_mrx_dut_phy_if, rmmi_mtx_dut_controller_if, rmmi_mrx_dut_controller_if (all svt_mphy_rmmi_* types) plus ssic_mtx_serial_if/ssic_mrx_serial_if (svt_mphy_serial_tx_if/_rx_if) which carry an explicit doc-comment caveat 'Use of this interface is not currently supported'. CAVEATS found (two DISTINCT not-yet-supported flags, do not conflate): (1) ULPI generally is flagged NotYetImplemented in the svt_usb_agent.sv class doc comment ('can be compiled and instantiated, but if submitted to the Agent will result in a NotYetImplemented exit from the simulator... ULPI is supported by an external block'); (2) svt_usb_utmi_dut_mac_if.svi itself carries its OWN separate doc-comment line 112: 'THIS INTERFACE IS NOT YET SUPPORTED!' -- i.e. even the UTMI+ DUT-MAC interface has its own not-yet-supported flag in this VIP release, independent of the ULPI caveat. Interface-level params on svt_usb_if: setup_time=1, hold_time=1, clock_recovery_enable=1, generate_pclk=1 -- doc comment stresses these must be mirrored exactly on the corresponding svt_usb_subenv_port*/port-creator object or connections silently mismatch. Debug signals at svt_usb_if top scope: testbench_clock plus 14 signals (physical_tx/rx_data[31:0]+_desc[255:0], link_tx_symbol_set_desc/_link_command_desc, link_tx/rx_packet[31:0]+_desc, protocol_tx/rx_transfer/_transaction[31:0]+_desc), exposed via 3 output-only modports svt_usb_physical_debug_port/svt_usb_link_debug_port/svt_usb_protocol_debug_port. Confirmed real DUT-facing modport names (grep-verified, name-level): svt_usb_pipe3_dut_mac_if.svi has svt_usb_pipe3_mac_port/_phy_port/_phy_monitor_port; svt_usb_pipe4_dut_mac_if.svi has svt_usb_pipe4_mac_port/_phy_port/_phy_monitor_port; svt_usb_ss_serial_if.svi has svt_usb_ss_serial_phy_port/_cable_port/_phy_monitor_port; svt_usb_20_serial_if.svi has svt_usb_20_serial_port/_monitor_port; svt_usb_ulpi_dut_mac_if.svi has svt_usb_ulpi_mac_port/_phy_port/_phy_monitor_port; svt_usb_iip_custom_adapter_dut_mac_if.svi REUSES the PIPE4 modport names (svt_usb_pipe4_mac_port/_phy_port/_phy_monitor_port), confirming the custom adapter is PIPE4-shaped; svt_usb_otg_if.svi has 7 modports covering DUT and VIP sides at MAC/PHY/serial layers plus a monitor (svt_usb_otg_dut_mac_port, _dut_phy_port, _dut_serial_port, _vip_mac_port, _vip_phy_port, _vip_serial_port, _monitor_port); svt_usb_hub_if.svi declares the interface (line 109) but defines NO modport at all in that file -- hub wiring goes through standard per-port svt_usb_if instances plus the svt_usb_hub_agent/svt_usb_hub_agent_configuration classes. svt_usb_utmi_dut_mac_if.svi full verified UTMI+ signal list: DataIn/DataOut [SVT_USB_MAX_UTMI_DATA_WIDTH-1:0] (width macro =16, include/sverilog/svt_usb_port_defines.svi:70), TXValid/TXValidH/TXReady, RXActive/RXValid/RXValidH/RXError, DataBus16_8, CLK, Reset, XcvrSelect, TermSelect, SuspendM, SleepM, L1SuspendM, LineState, OpMode, IdPullup/IdDig/AValid/BValid/VbusValid/SessEnd/DrvVbus/ChrgVbus/DischrgVbus/DpPulldown/DmPulldown/HostDisconnect (OTG signals present even on the UTMI interface), TxBitstuffEnable[H], and FS/LS serial-escape signals FsLsSerialMode/Tx_Enable_N/Tx_DAT/Tx_SE0/Rx_DP/Rx_DM/Rx_RCV/Vip_Speed[1:0] (00=LS,01=FS,10=HS_FS)/FsPullup/LsPullup; an `ifdef SVT_USB_EUSB2V2_UTMIV2 branch widens TX/RXValid and adds TXDataRate/RXDataRate/DataBusWidth/PortEnable/EnableComplianceMode/PHYResetB for eUSB2v2 variable-rate UTMI2.0 with a documented clock table covering 15/30/45/60/75/80/90/96/105/120/135/150/180/210/240/270/300 MHz. Key width/lane macros (include/sverilog/svt_usb_port_defines.svi): SVT_USB_MAX_PIPE3_DATA_WIDTH=32, SVT_USB_MAX_UTMI_DATA_WIDTH=16, SVT_USB_MAX_ULPI_DATA_WIDTH=8, SVT_USB_MAX_ADAPTER_DATA_WIDTH=512 (USB4 tunneling datapath), SVT_USB_MAX_SSIC_LANE_COUNT=4; SVT_USB_NUM_PHY_LANES=2 (svt_usb_common_defines.svi:179); SVT_USB_NUM_HUB_INST default 1 via `SVT_REPLACEABLE_DEFINE (svt_usb_common_defines.svi:6864, user-overridable before this header is included), which directly sizes svt_usb_system_virtual_sequencer::hub_virt_seqr[SVT_USB_NUM_HUB_INST].
